policy_check.claim: Prime must do business activity in Canada equal to 100% of contract value
policy_check.quote: contractually requires companies awarded defence procurement contracts to undertake business activity in Canada equal to the value of the contracts they have won

applies on all defence and Canadian Coast Guard procurements over $100 million that are not subject to trade agreements or for which the national security exception is invoked. Defence procurements valued between $25-100 million are reviewed
policy_check.caveat: Current text: applies to defence and Coast Guard procurements over $100M that are not subject to trade agreements or where the national security exception is invoked; $25-100M procurements are reviewed. The updated policy says the minimum contract value to apply the ITB Policy 'will increase to $25 million'. Pitch wording: 'applies to major defence procurements (over $100M, with $25M-$100M reviewed; the updated policy sets a $25M minimum)'.

policy_check.claim: Multipliers: SME direct 2x, skills and training 5x, Indigenous workforce development 10x
policy_check.quote: apply a 2x multiplier for performing direct work with a small and medium-sized business ... a new 5x multiplier for investments in skills development and training, and increase the current multiplier for initiatives supporting Indigenous workforce development to 10x, the largest available multiplier
policy_check.extra: New Strategic Investment Transaction multipliers: facility/R&D/Canadian IP (cash) 5x, IP transfer/exclusive licence (in-kind) 5x, equipment 4x, knowledge transfer 1x. SMB $1M transaction cap eliminated; new Small Mid-Cap category (>250 FTE keeps SMB crediting up to 5 years).

policy_check.claim: ITB authority moved to Defence Investment Agency on July 16, 2026; contact ITB-RIT@dia-aid.gc.ca
policy_check.quote: Authority for the Industrial and Technological Benefits (ITB) Policy has been transferred to the Defence Investment Agency (DIA), effective July 16, 2026. Please contact ITB-RIT@dia-aid.gc.ca

notes: Row data parsed from the inline 'companyJson' table on the two official ISED pages (data as of 2025-04-21). The official 'Company Contact and Email' column (named individuals + personal work emails) was deliberately DROPPED per Muster data rules (no personal names/emails); use the ISED page itself if a contact is needed. Values are in the currency shown on the page (CAD unless USD/EUR). progress_pct = completed_to_date/obligation (verified-completed only). '$-' on the page = 0. foreign_military_sale / irb_terms derived from the page's * and ** markers. The ITB policy URL in CLAUDE.md §11 (/site/industrial-technological-benefits/en/itb-policy) returned only a language-selection splash page on 2026-09-26; the overview page was used instead. The ITB overview page (date modified 2026-08-05) has not published new-policy contractor data; obligations reflect pre-transfer ISED data.

pitch_1.sentence: As of ISED's latest annual report (data as of April 21, 2025), defence contractors carried $83.8 billion in current ITB obligations to Canada. $40.1 billion is completed, and $23.4 billion has not yet been identified with any Canadian business activity.

pitch_2.sentence: Across the 102 current ITB obligations in Canadian dollars (ISED data as of April 21, 2025), primes had verified only 52% ($36.1B of $69.3B), which leaves $33.2B outstanding: $14.3B in progress and $18.9B not yet identified.

pitch_3.sentence: Canada's updated ITB policy (following the Defence Industrial Strategy) adds a new 5x credit multiplier for skills development and training and raises the multiplier for Indigenous workforce development to 10x, the largest available. That makes funded welder training a high-leverage way for a prime to earn ITB credit.
pitch_3.note: Second sentence is Muster's inference, not the source's.

do_not_say: 'contractors owe Canada $83.8B' ($40.1B of it is already completed)
'hasn't been matched to a Canadian supplier' (the page says 'not identified')
'$100M moving to $25M' (the page says the minimum 'will increase to $25 million')
pitch.verified: 2026-09-26 independent re-parse of both ISED pages; 122 rows match
